beta.changelog: * Fixed: on a product on sale, the "Keep reading" card shows the old price struck through next to the sale price, as the shop does.

* New: the Noxpress hub tells you when the other update channel has a newer version (in practice, a newer beta while the site follows Stable), with a counter on the Noxpress menu.
* New: "Install beta" for a single plugin, without moving the whole suite to Beta, or "Switch everything to Beta". Every package is still checked with sha256 and its signature.
* New: "Hide for this version" per user; the notice comes back with a newer version.
* Changed: Noxpress Core 1.1.0.

* First release (beta).
* Creator post type with photo, roles line, biography, links and lists of interviews, videos and reviews.
* Matching by slug across the chosen role attributes, with exclusions, extra terms and conflict detection.
* Creator page for classic and block themes, with one section per role, a bundles group and the press lists; one card per work with Product Formats.
* Links in "Additional information", creator box on the product, index with role filter and A–Z order; shortcodes and blocks.
* Draft creators from the terms, coverage check, settings export and import.
* ProfilePage and Person schema (Rank Math graph or standalone JSON-LD), creators on products as author, illustrator and more.
* Test mode, CRT_DISABLE, Greek and English texts, clean uninstall.

* Bulk conversion follows the bulk-change rule of Noxpress Bible §12: each change is written to the undo log before it happens; if that write fails, the item is left alone, the run stops and everything it changed goes back.
* "Download backup" saves the last run as JSON; Tools → Import checks it strictly and loads it back as the run to undo.
* Content and downloadable files change only while they still hold the value in the log; undo of downloadable files checks the same.

* Initial release.
* Rules per product category, with or without subcategories: hide products from the shop, other listings, search, related products / upsells / cross-sells, and product shortcodes and blocks (Product Collection, product grid blocks, Store API product list).
* "Only when all its categories are hidden" option, with a preview of affected products per rule.
* Hide the category itself from category lists, product categories and breadcrumbs; one-click rule for the default category.
* Category page: open, noindex (WordPress, Yoast, Rank Math), 404 or redirect to the shop; closed pages leave the core and Rank Math sitemaps.
* Import from "Hide Categories Or Products On Shop Page"; notice when FiboSearch is active.
* Test mode, HIC_DISABLE, page cache clearing on save, settings backup, clean uninstall.

* Initial release, with modules switched on one by one.
* Newsletter module: sign-up form (block, shortcode, widget) that posts to the list's orOS sign-up address, connection check, Greek and English texts.
* Unticked checkout checkbox (classic and block checkout); paid orders sent to orOS in the background with retries, order notes and a send log; consent kept in the order; optional confirmation for checkout sign-ups and a shop key that signs them.
* Test / live / off mode, ORC_DISABLE, privacy policy text, settings export / import.
* Works without WooCommerce. Noxpress hub and updates from noxpress.tech (Noxpress Core 1.1.8).

* Fixed: saving a bundle kept no record of the variations you ticked for a variable product, so the bundle page offered every variation of it. Bundles saved with 1.0.0 offer all variations until you tick them again and update the bundle.

* New: the Noxpress hub tells you when the other update channel has a newer version (in practice, a newer beta while the site follows Stable), with a counter on the Noxpress menu.
* New: "Install beta" for a single plugin, without moving the whole suite to Beta, or "Switch everything to Beta". Every package is still checked with sha256 and its signature.
* New: "Hide for this version" per user; the notice comes back with a newer version.
* Changed: Noxpress Core 1.1.0.

* Initial release.
* Server-side quote for editing, cover design, illustration, printing and extras (fixed, per item, per copy, per word, on request), with sizes, papers, bindings and finishes as templates, tiers, minimums, VAT per service and rounding per line.
* Hidden typesetting fee spread inside the services and shown as «Included»; prices with or without VAT; per-copy price and validity date.
* Block, shortcode and widget; works without JavaScript and with page caches.
* «I'm interested» requests with email to the owner, acknowledgement to the visitor, states, notes, CSV export, retention, privacy exporter and eraser, and an API for other plugins.
* Test / live / off mode, PBQ_DISABLE, test bench with the full breakdown, editable Greek and English texts, settings export / import.
* Works without WooCommerce. Noxpress hub and updates from noxpress.tech (Noxpress Core 1.1.10).

* Fixed: the tables in the beneficiary portal are readable on light themes such as Storefront. The theme's table colours turned the cells white with light text.
* Fixed: the live split total under the product's beneficiaries is readable on the white product box.
* Fixed: the internal regular-price stamp (_rs_reg_unit) no longer shows under each item on the order screen.

* Initial release.
* Free shipping progress bar in the classic cart, mini-cart and checkout and in the Cart and Checkout blocks; threshold from the WooCommerce shipping zones or fixed.
* Delivery time on the product page per shipping method, with preparation days per store, category and product, backorders, pre-orders, cut-off time, Saturday delivery and holidays (Greek holidays button).
* Optional dates and cut-off countdown computed in the browser for page-cache safety.
* Shortcodes `[nox_free_shipping]`, `[nox_delivery]` and two blocks.
* Editable Greek / English texts, preview tab, settings export / import.
* Test mode, SHN_DISABLE, HPOS and Cart / Checkout blocks compatible.
* Noxpress hub and updates from noxpress.tech (Noxpress Core 1.1.1).

* New: the Noxpress hub tells you when the other update channel has a newer version (in practice, a newer beta while the site follows Stable), with a counter on the Noxpress menu.
* New: "Install beta" for a single plugin, without moving the whole suite to Beta, or "Switch everything to Beta". Every package is still checked with sha256 and its signature.
* New: "Hide for this version" per user; the notice comes back with a newer version.
* Changed: Noxpress Core 1.1.0.

* New: "Plain text" rule in two modes, keep line breaks or one paragraph. It removes every HTML tag and attribute (including `data-path-to-node` from text copied from AI tools), turns ` ` into spaces, removes zero-width characters and collapses blank lines; shortcodes stay. It works on every field; the dry run counts the fields that lose a link, an image or a table.
* New: optional "Clean on save" setting: the short description becomes plain text when a product is saved from its edit screen. Included in the state export / import.
* New: "Download backup" for every run in the history (JSON, importable from SF Settings).
* Fixed: the backup of a run is now written before the products change. Before, products were saved first, so a failed backup write left changes without undo.
* Fixed: a backup that would not fit (4 MB per run) was silently cut, dropping the oldest units. Apply now checks the size first and does not start; if a batch still does not fit, the run stops safely and everything changed so far restores in full.
* Fixed: a value that changed between the check and the write is skipped instead of being overwritten.
* Fixed: on narrow screens the history table scrolls on its own instead of widening the whole page.

* New: "No pickup" rule: products of the chosen shipping classes (e.g. print on demand) remove the pickup method from the cart, with a message in the cart and checkout totals. Off by default. Filter `pkp_pickup_allowed`.
* New: `[pkp_stores]` shortcode with the active stores (address, hours, details, map), optionally `ids="…"`.
* New: "Pickup at: <store>" line at the top of the admin New order email (HTML and plain text), on by default.
* New: texts for the "No pickup" message and the admin line (Greek / English); the backup includes the new settings.
* Fixed: the publisher profit card says "Publisher profit (last month)" instead of "Publisher profit (period) (last month)".

* New: sale badge text for the whole site (Prices tab): a template such as "Sale {percent}" with `{percent}` and `{amount}`, an "up to" text for variable and grouped products with different discounts, a fallback text, an optional product page text, a minimum percentage and rounding (down by default). Greek and English. Off until enabled.
* New: it covers WooCommerce's sale badge in classic themes (`woocommerce_sale_flash`), the Product Sale Badge block (`woocommerce_sale_badge_text`, WooCommerce 10.0+) and the badge of Theme Patcher's own card slot. The theme's badge element and classes are kept.
* New: one-click import of the sale texts of Customizer for WooCommerce, with a reminder while that plugin is still active.
* New: filter `tp_sale_badge_text`. The sale badge settings are included in the settings backup.

* Initial release.
* Swatch types per attribute and per product: text button, color (two-tone), image, variation image, radio list, dropdown.
* Value looks (color, second color, image, short label) on attribute terms and on custom product attributes.
* Shape, size, font size, border width and colors with a live preview.
* Blurred / crossed / hidden values for missing combinations and out of stock; smart selection; "Color: Black"; tooltip with name, image, price difference and low stock.
* Automatic selection, deselect on second click, choices in the page address.
* Size guides by category or per product, in an accessible dialog.
* Swatches on shop cards with image swap and pre-selected links.
* Availability maps built in the background (Action Scheduler) for products with many variations.
* Import from CartFlows Variation Swatches, Variation Swatches (GetWooPlugins) and WCBoost Variation Swatches.
* Color dot in the cart and mini-cart.
* Editable Greek / English texts, settings export / import.
* Test mode, VPK_DISABLE, HPOS compatible.
* Noxpress hub and updates from noxpress.tech (Noxpress Core 1.1.6).
